data.one_liner: An expandable and collapsible accordion list widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a stylish accordion widget where sections can be expanded or collapsed by clicking their headers. Supports global and individual styling properties, haptic feedback, automatic scrolling of opened items, and nested accordions.
use_when: You need an expandable FAQ list or collapsible sections in your UI.
You want customizable header and content styling with built-in animations.
avoid_when: You wrap the entire accordion in a global state management system that triggers full rebuilds during opening animations.
You need complex data grid or tree structures rather than simple collapsible sections.
strengths: Many preset properties for styling headers and content globally or per section.
Supports auto-closing previous sections via maxOpenSections.
Built-in scroll into view and haptic feedback options.
weaknesses: Improper state management placement around the widget can cause unintended opening animation replays.
data.minimal_example:
Accordion(
  maxOpenSections: 1,
  headerBackgroundColorOpened: Colors.black54,
  headerPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 15, vertical: 8),
  children: [
    AccordionSection(
      isOpen: true,
      header: Text('Section 1', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 15)),
      content: Text('Inside Accordion 1'),
    ),
  ],
)
